scope: Separately frozen post-repair diagnostic stage; not the 36-cell/2000-cohort qualification matrix, clinical validation, or an acceptance decision
rng: NumPy PCG64; SeedSequence(seed).spawn(6) in listed cell order; each cell spawns 20 cohorts; each cohort spawns four streams for means, libraries, nuisance batch coefficients and counts
hypothesis_selection: g000 through g031; fixed before observing counts; no filtering
batch_assignment: Alternating A/B within each balanced time; two subjects per time/batch for n24 and four for n48; every sample has its own independent biological unit

log_library_distribution.name: normal
log_library_distribution.centering: subtract within-cohort sampled log-factor mean before exponentiating

count_distribution: Negative binomial with mean mu and variance mu + alpha * mu^2; NumPy n=1/alpha, p=n/(n+mu)
mean_model: mu[g,s] = base_mean[g] * library_factor[s] * exp(batch_coefficient[g] * I(batch B) + effect_amplitude * curve[g,time[s]])

mixed_effects.amplitude_definition: log(4); each alternative curve has peak-to-trough range 1, giving a fourfold temporal mean range before nuisance and library factors
mixed_effects.model_scope: Fixed data-generating curves; nonlinear alternatives need not lie exactly in the tested three-df spline subspace. Power is empirical detection under these explicit generators, not effect-estimation validation.

wheel.name: devharness-0.4.4-py3-none-any.whl
wheel.isolation: Verified full extraction with frozen file inventory; every child uses extracted cwd and PYTHONPATH, -B/-s and explicit module-origin checks; no current controlled source imports

reporting.null_rejection_fraction: Within-cohort rejected true-null hypotheses divided by the prespecified true-null count (32 complete-null, 16 mixed)
reporting.fdp: False BH discoveries divided by max(all BH discoveries,1); zero if no discoveries
reporting.fdr: Mean cohort FDP, with cohorts as the independent simulation replicates
reporting.power: Mixed cells only: true BH discoveries / 16 alternatives, plus descriptive shape-specific detection / 4
reporting.primary_warning_family: 24 prespecified slots: null rejection fraction and FDR for every one of 6 cells and 2 engines
reporting.simultaneous_warning: Bonferroni family alpha 0.05 across all 24 slots. Warn only if one-sided lower confidence bound exceeds 0.05. Use exact Clopper-Pearson for complete-null FDR (Bernoulli any-discovery); use Hoeffding bounded-cohort lower bounds for null-rejection fractions and mixed FDP. Require all 20 cohorts usable for a primary warning assessment. No absence-of-warning acceptance claim.
reporting.descriptive_intervals: Two-sided 95% exact Clopper-Pearson for complete-null BH occurrence; otherwise distribution-free Hoeffding mean bounds clipped to the metric range. Power is descriptive; no clinical success margin.
reporting.paired_differences: DESeq2 minus edgeR per matched usable cohort; mean differences for null rejection, FDP and mixed power with two-sided 95% Hoeffding bounds on [-1,1]. Incomplete matched sets are explicitly conditional on usable runs.
reporting.missingness: Report planned, attempted, terminal, usable and failed cohorts, unavailable hypotheses, complete-case summaries and all-attempt missingness bounds. Never replace missing probabilities with 0/1 or classify failed cohorts as successful negatives.
reporting.main_target_outstanding: Broader 36-cell matrix, 2000 independent cohorts per stochastic cell, stress scenarios, analytical/clinical validation and independent qualification

integrity: Freeze this protocol, runner, verified wheel extraction, all generated inputs/truth/seeds, public fixture registry, signed plans and approvals before fitting. Stop scheduling on frozen-file drift, infrastructure blocker or invalid audit evidence; do not retry measured attempts. Retain every start/outcome, raw stdout/stderr, result and available receipt. Ephemeral fixture private keys remain in memory only; their signatures do not establish human approval or clinical authorization.
